_about: planning-reference (Planning & Interviews): wording, conditions, units and bounds from the plain-pages audit (2026-09-27). The fewest and most questions per topic bound each other; the attachment size is shown in MB and stored in bytes.

planning.interview.plan-default-depth.label: Plan depth
planning.interview.plan-default-depth.help: Quick sketches fast; Thorough looks carefully first.

planning.interview.deep-plan-default-dep.label: Deep Plan depth
planning.interview.deep-plan-default-dep.help: BrainStorm adds several thinkers who debate and vote.

planning.interview.deep-plan-grill-me.label: Start Deep Plans with Grill Me
planning.interview.deep-plan-grill-me.help: Lets it ask you more questions first; change it per plan.

planning.interview.auto-open-deep-plan.label: Open finished plans for review
planning.interview.auto-open-deep-plan.help: Read and mark up a Deep Plan before anything runs.

planning.interview.plan-panel-sticky.label: Keep the plan visible while work runs

planning.interview.plan-default-export.label: Export plans as
planning.interview.plan-default-export.help: Both formats stay available on every plan.

planning.interview.recommend-wizard.label: Offer the Planning Wizard for big requests

planning.interview.plan-thoroughness.label: How thorough the wizard's plan is
planning.interview.plan-thoroughness.help: Comprehensive does more research and takes longer.

planning.interview.web-research-mode.label: Look things up on the web while planning

planning.interview.require-arch-confirma.label: Ask me to approve the tech choices

planning.interview.builder-topics.label: Topics the interview covers
planning.interview.builder-topics.help: Skipped topics are faster but the plan guesses more.

planning.interview.topic-depth.label: Default depth for each topic
planning.interview.topic-depth.help: Skip leaves a topic out unless you pick it for a session.

planning.interview.scope-probe-questions.label: Opening questions
planning.interview.scope-probe-questions.help: Quick questions to size the project before topics start.

planning.interview.min-questions-per-top.label: Fewest questions per topic
planning.interview.min-questions-per-top.help: Must be lower than the most questions per topic.

planning.interview.max-questions-per-top.label: Most questions per topic
planning.interview.max-questions-per-top.help: One extra question is allowed to finish a thought.

planning.interview.vision-provider.label: Who reads pictures and screenshots
planning.interview.vision-provider.help: Media & Vision has the app-wide choice; this one is for planning.

planning.interview.prefer-gemini-gui.label: Prefer Gemini for screens and pictures
planning.interview.prefer-gemini-gui.help: Only when it is connected and the choice above is Automatic.

planning.interview.builder-intake-person.label: Helper who asks the first questions

planning.interview.topic-checklist.label: Hand-picked topics (this session)
planning.interview.topic-checklist.help: Unchecked topics are skipped this time only.

planning.interview.run-all-topics.label: Ask every topic in full (this session)

planning.interview.builder-preferences.label: Expert overrides
planning.interview.builder-preferences.help: Fine-grained wizard overrides; most people never need these.

branching.plan.quick-question-limit.label: Quick plan
branching.plan.quick-question-limit.help: Grill Me adds more (set in Personas › Crews).

branching.plan.standard-question-limit.label: Standard plan
branching.plan.standard-question-limit.help: Grill Me adds more (set in Personas › Crews).

branching.plan.thorough-question-limit.label: Thorough plan
branching.plan.thorough-question-limit.help: Grill Me adds more (set in Personas › Crews).

branching.deep-plan.thorough-question-li.label: Deep Plan, Thorough
branching.deep-plan.thorough-question-li.help: Grill Me adds more (set in Personas › Crews).

branching.deep-plan.exhaustive-question-.label: Deep Plan, Exhaustive
branching.deep-plan.exhaustive-question-.help: Grill Me adds more (set in Personas › Crews).

planning.interview.requirements-upload-o.label: Order of attached files (this session)
planning.interview.requirements-upload-o.help: Earlier files win when documents disagree.
